description: Daily Deals / shop price reference for buy-vs-farm analysis. Two sources: the local datamine (authoritative config) and tacticus.wiki.gg (community, may lag). Conflicts are flagged. Farm-side costs come from energy_cost.py, not from this file.

datamine_key_paths.daily_deal_pool: $.clientGameConfig.shop.merchants.<name>.products[][]  (reward, cost{type,amount}, cronSchedule '0 0 0 ? * * *' = daily, maxPurchases, conditions.lockId, weight)

energy_refills_blackstone.note: BS -> energy ladder. BS/E rises steeply; everything past ~110 BS is worse value than buying items outright.
energy_refills_blackstone.conflict: wiki lists 110 BS for the 3rd refill; user memory said 100 BS. Patch 1.31 'added one more refill of 60 Energy for 25 Blackstone' suggests 2x25 BS refills may exist. Wiki has no 100 BS row.
energy_refills_blackstone.unverified: slot 8 of Daily Deals reportedly lists 'Energy x60 -> 150 RT' (likely typo); a 2026-09 Reddit thread claims energy no longer appears in Daily Deals at all.

single_upgrade_items_blackstone.note: RESOLVED - these are two different products (see conflicts_resolved.slot_3_vs_slot_9).

random_rarity_chest__slot_3.note: loot.dropTables.upgrades* = randomRoll of that tier - NOT a chosen item
random_rarity_chest__slot_3.wiki_label: wiki's 5/10/25/60/150 BS and 200/400/1000/2400/6000 coins are these chests, mislabeled as singles

other_currencies_singles.note: same upg* singles also sold in non-gem shops

typical_single_bs.note: Representative chosen-rarity single price per rarity, used by item_value.py's static SHOP/VERDICT columns (ladder B slot-9 modes: Epic 200|225|240 -> 225 with E1xx series at 675, Legendary 320-755 -> mode 690 with L1xx 1655-1790 / L2xx 2880, Mythic 2790|3005|3675 -> 3000). Common singles are NOT sold - 5 BS is the slot-3 random-rarity common chest. The cheaper chest ladder (5/10/25/60/150) is a DIFFERENT product (random item of the tier); exact offers are priced per item with --price.

blackstone_income.subscription: Daily Shipment, $4.99 per 30 days (first purchase $2.99): 200 BS up-front + 60 BS/day = 2,000 BS / 30 days, ~67 BS/day effective - user's '60 BS/day for $5/month' VERIFIED (tacticus.wiki.gg/wiki/Shops)

promo_codes.where: official Discord #Promo-Codes-AKA-Rat-Gave-Up + ~50 partnered creators; dated log at tacticus.wiki.gg/wiki/2026Freebies
promo_codes.frequency: ~30-50 codes/month, only ~15-25% carry BS, usually 20-50 BS each; flash/outage codes 100-500
promo_codes.redemption: Home > Settings > Input code; case-sensitive, one per account, flash codes often expire in 24-48h; needs campaign battle 15

other_sources: free battle pass track +60 BS per 5-week season
blackstone_income.note: Web research 2026-09-27. The 185 BS/day refill habit already outspends the subscription, so shop items are funded from the promo/salvage surplus - the spender profiles are signals over that surplus, not a strict budget. BS-in-codes trended down since June 2026; treat the high case as event-dependent.

markup_if_datamine_prices.verdict: hypothesis confirmed IF the merchant rarity ladder is what the shop charges - markup grows with rarity

markup_if_wiki_prices.verdict: still monotonically increasing with rarity (1.8x -> 14x), but far less extreme

composites.wiki: slot 9 sells a crafted upgrade; price = sum of component BS prices; full Legendary craft 1600-1800 BS (saves ~4 days); 3 Legendary singles = 18000 coins or 450 BS
composites.rule: fair price = expand recipe tree and sum leaf farm costs (energy_cost.price with empty inventory) - never price against the top-level item

coins.note: coins can be bought with BS, never the reverse

ev_from_weights.note: base weights, mercy ignored, before duplicate-to-shard conversion
ev_from_weights.tables: loot.dropTables.summoningPortal (total 14487: heroesLegendary 87, step_2 14400) -> step_2 (total 286: heroesAllWithoutLegendary 46, machinesOfWar 5, shards 170, orbs 65)

requisition.community_verdict: not worth it - no numeric EV table published

real_money_blackstone.first_buy: double blackstone on first purchase of each cash bundle

daily_deals_layout.slot_1: free crate every day (after refresh: a rare upgrade at discount)
daily_deals_layout.slot_2: single upgrades priced in coins (see conflict)
daily_deals_layout.slot_3: single upgrades in blackstone; components x10 = 99; munitions 75/150; shards x10 = 350
daily_deals_layout.slot_8: XP books / raid tickets (weekends weighted to XP)
daily_deals_layout.slot_9: crafted (composite) upgrade, price = sum of components
daily_deals_layout.pool_is_random: datamine gives only the weighted pool (weight, conditions.minPowerLevel, lockId) - today's picks are server-rolled, no fixed calendar exists

buy_vs_farm_rules.1: Buy refills at 25 and 50 BS (0.417 and 0.5 BS/E); the 110 BS tier (1.1 BS/E) is the community's accepted last refill.
buy_vs_farm_rules.2: Past that, direct item purchases beat energy refills - community consensus: 'buy energy at 50 and 110 BS, after that buy cheaper upgrades (common, uncommon, rare) from daily shop'.
buy_vs_farm_rules.3: Buying wins only when attempts (10/day standard, 6/day elite per node), event rotation, or calendar time are binding - node caps ~9 Common / 6-7 Rare / 4 Epic / 2-3 Legendary per Elite node per day.
buy_vs_farm_rules.4: Gold-priced Daily Deals are widely considered fine (coins are plentiful); BS-priced deals are widely considered 'very overpriced'.
buy_vs_farm_rules.5: Compare any price against fair_price_floor_bs first, then decide if the premium is buying you time you do not have.

conflicts_resolved.slot_3_vs_slot_9: RESOLVED 2026-09-27 - they are DIFFERENT PRODUCTS, not rival prices. Ladder (A) 5/10/25/60/150 BS is slot 3's RANDOM-rarity chest (loot.dropTables.upgrades* = type randomRoll over that tier, n=1 per tier). Ladder (B) 30/80/~225/~690/~3000 BS is the chosen-rarity single upg* pool in slot 9 (351 entries, every one lockId=lock_daily_deal_<id>, maxPurchases 2, daily cron). Markups in fair_price_floor_bs use (B) for singles.
conflicts_resolved.coin_ladder: wiki 200/400/1000/2400/6000 vs datamine gold 150/300/750/2400/6000 - datamine has both amounts (150|200, 300|400, 750|1000) as separate entries; wiki likely shows the higher one. Unresolved, immaterial.
conflicts_resolved.third_refill: RESOLVED: datamine staminaShopTiers = 25/50/110/250/500/1000/1500 - it is 110 BS, not 100.

conflicts: wiki has no Mythic in Daily Deals; datamine merchant pool has 30 Mythic slots (2790/3005/3675 gems)
requisition EV: now computed from weights (see requisition.ev) - no community table published
not_found: fixed weekday rotation calendar for Daily Deals (pool is random/weighted)
single Mythic item listings in Daily Deals (wiki), only in Crusade/Rogue Trader/Guild shops
